summary: PDF-blank-bug verification — FAILED. The applied fix in /app/frontend/src/utils/invoicePdf.ts does NOT work on the web preview: the popup opens BUT is completely blank (body.innerText.length == 0 for BOTH the GST Invoice and the Kacha Bill). Root cause identified: openHtmlForPrintWeb() calls `window.open('', '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer,width=900,height=1000')`. Per the HTML spec (see MDN), when the windowFeatures string contains `noopener` (or `noreferrer`), `window.open()` returns `null`. The subsequent guard `if (!win || !win.document) return false;` therefore fails silently, logging `[invoicePdf] web print blocked (popup?)` (visible in console), and NOTHING is ever written into the popup document. Result: a blank tab — exact same user-visible symptom as the original bug. TEST A: FAIL (0 chars). TEST B: FAIL (0 chars). TEST C: FAIL (0 chars). TEST D: PASS (no pageerror). TEST E: PASS (both counters incremented 0001→0002 independently, confirming save still works).

S1_shop_config.evidence: All 13 fields filled and Save Changes tapped; no error. On reload, shop-inv-next=0001, shop-kacha-next=0001 (starting values).

TEST_A_gst_invoice_pdf.evidence: Popup opened (Playwright captured it) but body.innerText length = 0. Missing ALL required keywords. Console showed: '[invoicePdf] web print blocked (popup?)'. First 200 chars of popup body: '' (empty).

ui_bugs.issue: window.open() is called with windowFeatures='noopener,noreferrer,width=900,height=1000'. Per HTML spec, when noopener/noreferrer is set in windowFeatures, window.open() ALWAYS returns null — the caller cannot access the child window. The guard `if (!win || !win.document) return false;` then fails and NOTHING is written into the new tab. Result: the popup is a completely blank tab, which reproduces the exact original 'blank PDF' user bug. Reference: /app/frontend/src/utils/invoicePdf.ts:595

Even if noopener/noreferrer is removed, popup-blocking policies still require the window.open() call to be inside a synchronous user-gesture callback. Currently it is called from an async chain (generateAndShareInvoice → openHtmlForPrintWeb) triggered by React's TouchableOpacity onPress. Because there is no await before window.open(), this SHOULD still be within the gesture, but wrapping the generation in Promise/setTimeout can break it. Confirm the call is still synchronous relative to the click. Reference: /app/frontend/src/utils/invoicePdf.ts:619-629

integration_issues.issue: End-to-end blank popup. The fix summary says the web-preview flow 'opens a NEW WINDOW, writes the invoice HTML directly, and auto-triggers window.print()' — verified: the new window OPENS, but NO HTML is written into it because window.open() returned null due to noopener/noreferrer feature flag.

action_items: CRITICAL FIX: In /app/frontend/src/utils/invoicePdf.ts line 595, remove 'noopener,noreferrer' from the windowFeatures string of window.open(). Change from `g.window.open('', '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer,width=900,height=1000')` to `g.window.open('', '_blank', 'width=900,height=1000')`. Per MDN, specifying noopener/noreferrer forces the return value to null, so the subsequent guard aborts and nothing is written. This is why the popup renders blank.

Optional safer alternative: create a Blob URL from the HTML string and open that: `const blob = new Blob([html], {type:'text/html'}); const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const win = window.open(url, '_blank');` then add the auto-print via a query flag or by injecting the script into the HTML before creating the blob.
After the fix, re-run this iteration's script to verify TEST A / B / C all pass (body length > 500 with all required keywords present).

Native (iOS/Android) A4 dimensions fix could NOT be verified from web preview — recommend a manual smoke test on an Expo Go device or dev-build to confirm the A4_WIDTH_PT / A4_HEIGHT_PT change also renders content on Android (the original blank-on-native symptom).

Consider centralising the invoicePdf module test with a small Node-level unit test that snapshots buildGstInvoiceHtml() / buildKachaBillHtml() outputs — this at least guarantees the HTML BUILDER is producing the expected content, isolating the failure to the delivery mechanism.
critical_code_review_comments: invoicePdf.ts openHtmlForPrintWeb(): window.open with noopener,noreferrer + feature-string ALWAYS returns null — this is the exact failure mode being hit. The console warning '[invoicePdf] web print blocked (popup?)' misdiagnoses the cause as popup-blocker; it's actually the noopener flag.

invoicePdf.ts pickBuilder(): correctly routes 'Kacha Bill' and 'Non-GST Invoice' to buildKachaBillHtml, and everything else to buildGstInvoiceHtml. invoicePdf.ts:634-640 native path: A4_WIDTH_PT=595, A4_HEIGHT_PT=842 explicitly passed to printToFileAsync and margins=20pt applied on all 4 sides. This aligns with the fix description and CSS @page A4 8mm rule. Cannot verify runtime on web preview — requires device build.

Web-print HTML injection script (line 607-610) uses window.addEventListener('load', ...) + setTimeout 250ms before window.print(). Fine — but never executes because doc.write never runs (win is null).
There is no ObjectId leakage, no async/sync bugs, no env-var hardcoding in the modified file. Scope of the fix is correctly confined to /app/frontend/src/utils/invoicePdf.ts as described.

rca_of_issue: SYMPTOM: user clicks 'Generate Bill' → PDF is blank. FIX ATTEMPTED: replace expo-print's data-URI-HTML approach with window.open() + doc.write() + auto window.print(). ACTUAL BUG IN FIX: the feature string 'noopener,noreferrer,width=900,height=1000' passed to window.open causes the function to return null (documented HTML-spec behaviour: any noopener/noreferrer in features → return value is nullified so the opener cannot script the child). The code then hits `if (!win || !win.document) return false;` and exits — logging '[invoicePdf] web print blocked (popup?)' — WITHOUT writing any HTML into the popup document. Some browsers still visibly create the blank tab even though the return is null (which is why Playwright detects a popup at all, and why the user sees a blank page instead of nothing happening). REPRODUCTION: (1) login owner@test.com; (2) fill /admin/shop; (3) /sales/new → any bill → Save; (4) /billing → share-sale-<id> → popup opens BLANK. MITIGATION: Remove 'noopener,noreferrer' from windowFeatures. Example: `g.window.open('', '_blank', 'width=900,height=1000')`. This keeps the reference, doc.write() runs, HTML populates, window.print() fires.
